question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our VNA solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly identify the competitor’s exact VNA model/options and official or third-party validated specifications, the R&S VNA model/options and specification conditions, the Semiconductor application or DUT/test setup, and any comparison data measured under stated and comparable conditions; the current passages show multiple gaps where competitor model, option code, performance, test conditions, and direct comparison evidence are not provided [7][29][32][40][82].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party validation for the exact competitor VNA model, SKU, option codes, release status, and test conditions. | R&S battle-card descriptions of Keysight competitors are explicitly stated to need Keysight official data or third-party validation, and the available Keysight material lacks formal datasheets, SKU details, option codes, release status, and test conditions [7]. | Current Keysight PCB/VNA-related sources list ENA/PNA but do not provide concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, or performance indicators [29][32]. |
| Competitor performance metrics with measurement conditions, not just product-family names. | Keysight ENA/PNA pages state that the sources do not provide performance indicators, so measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth are not recorded [29][32]. | The Keysight PCB image sources support only tool/process names such as ENA/PNA, Delta-L, TDR, and Dk/Df context, not product specifications or performance comparison [34][90]. |
| R&S exact product configuration, document version, and warranted-vs-typical status for every metric used in the comparison. | R&S ZNA specifications define “specifications with limits” as warranted performance, while typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1]. | R&S ZNA has a documented specification source, PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026, covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 [47][48]. |
| R&S metric conditions, such as frequency range, measurement bandwidth, firmware/OS, calibration, and whether values are specification, typical, or measured. | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range, sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and speed examples with conditions, including values that are specification, typical, nominal, or measured [45][49]. | Any comparison must preserve those conditions, because the passages distinguish guaranteed specifications from typical or measured data [1][45]. |
| Semiconductor-specific application evidence tying the VNA solution to the semiconductor use case, not just a generic product spec. | The AISeverEcosystem mapping lists R&S ZNA + ZNA67EXT and R&S FSWP for IC / silicon IP / process, but it explicitly does not say whether the measurement object is SerDes, jitter, phase noise, probe station, wafer, or package [82]. | The same mapping lists R&S ZNA67EXT for a test-interface company but does not specify probe card, socket, fixture, or frequency range [82]. |
| Direct comparison data between R&S and the competitor for the same Semiconductor application, DUT, and test setup. | The Samsung semiconductor-related case lists R&S FSWP50, SMW200A, SGS100A, competitor Keysight E5052B and VXG, and a 5G SoC including VCO, but the source provides no Keysight E5052B or VXG comparison data, so the competitor field is only sales-case context [40][42]. | The passages do not provide a direct VNA-vs-competitor comparison for Semiconductor with shared DUT, setup, metrics, or measured results [40][82]. |
| Complete test setup evidence: DUT, fixture/probe station, calibration method, frequency range, software version, and de-embedding method. | Semiconductor and high-speed interconnect cases show that win factors may involve total solution elements such as probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner rather than a single instrument specification [11]. | Several case summaries explicitly lack DUT details, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, extender, probe, calibration, and de-embedding method [10][59]. |
| Comparable measurement conditions for numerical claims. | ZNB3000 measurement accuracy requires calibration and measurement frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be the same, with no interpolation [14]. | ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, and dynamic range can increase with 1 Hz measurement bandwidth, showing that conditions materially affect comparison claims [73]. |
| Evidence that market/customer claims are not being inferred from mapping or images. | AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping is only a sales/testing-solution lead and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [27]. | Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, market share, or R&S relationship claims [34]. |
### What cannot be claimed from the current passages
The current passages support that R&S ZNA and ZNB are VNA product lines with documented specifications, but they do not support a claim that they outperform Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor because the Keysight sources lack exact model, option, performance, and test-condition data [29][32][45][47].  
The current passages support that R&S ZNA/ZNA67EXT appears in semiconductor-adjacent IC and test-interface sales mappings, but they do not establish a verified Semiconductor test configuration or customer adoption because the mapping lacks measurement object, probe/fixture, and frequency-range details [27][82].  
The current passages support that a Samsung Foundry RF/Analog Enablement case names R&S instruments and Keysight competitors, but they do not provide comparison data, so it cannot be used as evidence that the R&S solution is better than the competitor solution [40][42].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › p001（讀圖）
- 可見文字：R&S®ZNB3000、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER、Specifications、Version 09.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real、ZNB Vector Network Analyzer。
- 頁面為文件封面樣式，主體是 R&S ZNB3000 VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER 儀器照片。
- 儀器正面有大螢幕、右側實體按鍵與旋鈕、左右把手、前面板下方多個射頻連接埠。
- 螢幕顯示多個網路分析儀量測圖窗；圖表細部標示、座標數值與按鍵文字多數無法辨識。
- 可清楚辨識的數值只有 Version 09.00。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 所有 specification data 在 **+18 °C to +28 °C** 有效；measurement accuracy 另要求 calibration 後 temperature variation 不得超過 **1 °C**，且 measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須相同，不允許 interpolation。
- Measurement range：impedance 50 Ω；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。
- Dynamic range 規格以 10 Hz measurement bandwidth、without user correction applied 為條件；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Measurement speed 以 firmware version 4.12 與 Windows 11 測得；來源註明 sweep time 應理解為 cycle time。
- General data：operating temperature +5 °C to +40 °C；storage temperature –20 °C to +60 °C；calibration interval 1 year；power supply 100 V to 240 V ±10 %，50 Hz to 60 Hz and 400 Hz，max. 3.5 A。
- Ordering information 列出 base units、frequency upgrade options、extended power range、receiver step attenuators、extended dynamic range、hardware options、software / measurement options、calibration accessories、power sensors、attenuators、switch matrices、test cables、hardware add-ons、warranty and service options。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 原文未解的問題

- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

### Short answer
To compare our VNA solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly identify the competitor’s exact VNA model/options and official or third-party validated specifications, the R&S VNA model/options and specification conditions, the Semiconductor application or DUT/test setup, and any comparison data measured under stated and comparable conditions; the current passages show multiple gaps where competitor model, option code, performance, test conditions, and direct comparison evidence are not provided [7][29][32][40][82].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party validation for the exact competitor VNA model, SKU, option codes, release status, and test conditions. | R&S battle-card descriptions of Keysight competitors are explicitly stated to need Keysight official data or third-party validation, and the available Keysight material lacks formal datasheets, SKU details, option codes, release status, and test conditions [7]. | Current Keysight PCB/VNA-related sources list ENA/PNA but do not provide concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, or performance indicators [29][32]. |
| Competitor performance metrics with measurement conditions, not just product-family names. | Keysight ENA/PNA pages state that the sources do not provide performance indicators, so measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth are not recorded [29][32]. | The Keysight PCB image sources support only tool/process names such as ENA/PNA, Delta-L, TDR, and Dk/Df context, not product specifications or performance comparison [34][90]. |
| R&S exact product configuration, document version, and warranted-vs-typical status for every metric used in the comparison. | R&S ZNA specifications define “specifications with limits” as warranted performance, while typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1]. | R&S ZNA has a documented specification source, PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026, covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 [47][48]. |
| R&S metric conditions, such as frequency range, measurement bandwidth, firmware/OS, calibration, and whether values are specification, typical, or measured. | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range, sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and speed examples with conditions, including values that are specification, typical, nominal, or measured [45][49]. | Any comparison must preserve those conditions, because the passages distinguish guaranteed specifications from typical or measured data [1][45]. |
| Semiconductor-specific application evidence tying the VNA solution to the semiconductor use case, not just a generic product spec. | The AISeverEcosystem mapping lists R&S ZNA + ZNA67EXT and R&S FSWP for IC / silicon IP / process, but it explicitly does not say whether the measurement object is SerDes, jitter, phase noise, probe station, wafer, or package [82]. | The same mapping lists R&S ZNA67EXT for a test-interface company but does not specify probe card, socket, fixture, or frequency range [82]. |
| Direct comparison data between R&S and the competitor for the same Semiconductor application, DUT, and test setup. | The Samsung semiconductor-related case lists R&S FSWP50, SMW200A, SGS100A, competitor Keysight E5052B and VXG, and a 5G SoC including VCO, but the source provides no Keysight E5052B or VXG comparison data, so the competitor field is only sales-case context [40][42]. | The passages do not provide a direct VNA-vs-competitor comparison for Semiconductor with shared DUT, setup, metrics, or measured results [40][82]. |
| Complete test setup evidence: DUT, fixture/probe station, calibration method, frequency range, software version, and de-embedding method. | Semiconductor and high-speed interconnect cases show that win factors may involve total solution elements such as probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner rather than a single instrument specification [11]. | Several case summaries explicitly lack DUT details, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, extender, probe, calibration, and de-embedding method [10][59]. |
| Comparable measurement conditions for numerical claims. | ZNB3000 measurement accuracy requires calibration and measurement frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be the same, with no interpolation [14]. | ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, and dynamic range can increase with 1 Hz measurement bandwidth, showing that conditions materially affect comparison claims [73]. |
| Evidence that market/customer claims are not being inferred from mapping or images. | AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping is only a sales/testing-solution lead and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [27]. | Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, market share, or R&S relationship claims [34]. |
### What cannot be claimed from the current passages
The current passages support that R&S ZNA and ZNB are VNA product lines with documented specifications, but they do not support a claim that they outperform Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor because the Keysight sources lack exact model, option, performance, and test-condition data [29][32][45][47].  
The current passages support that R&S ZNA/ZNA67EXT appears in semiconductor-adjacent IC and test-interface sales mappings, but they do not establish a verified Semiconductor test configuration or customer adoption because the mapping lacks measurement object, probe/fixture, and frequency-range details [27][82].  
The current passages support that a Samsung Foundry RF/Analog Enablement case names R&S instruments and Keysight competitors, but they do not provide comparison data, so it cannot be used as evidence that the R&S solution is better than the competitor solution [40][42].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。

### Short answer
To compare our VNA solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly identify the competitor’s exact VNA model/options and official or third-party validated specifications, the R&S VNA model/options and specification conditions, the Semiconductor application or DUT/test setup, and any comparison data measured under stated and comparable conditions; the current passages show multiple gaps where competitor model, option code, performance, test conditions, and direct comparison evidence are not provided [7][29][32][40][82].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party validation for the exact competitor VNA model, SKU, option codes, release status, and test conditions. | R&S battle-card descriptions of Keysight competitors are explicitly stated to need Keysight official data or third-party validation, and the available Keysight material lacks formal datasheets, SKU details, option codes, release status, and test conditions [7]. | Current Keysight PCB/VNA-related sources list ENA/PNA but do not provide concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, or performance indicators [29][32]. |
| Competitor performance metrics with measurement conditions, not just product-family names. | Keysight ENA/PNA pages state that the sources do not provide performance indicators, so measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth are not recorded [29][32]. | The Keysight PCB image sources support only tool/process names such as ENA/PNA, Delta-L, TDR, and Dk/Df context, not product specifications or performance comparison [34][90]. |
| R&S exact product configuration, document version, and warranted-vs-typical status for every metric used in the comparison. | R&S ZNA specifications define “specifications with limits” as warranted performance, while typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1]. | R&S ZNA has a documented specification source, PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026, covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 [47][48]. |
| R&S metric conditions, such as frequency range, measurement bandwidth, firmware/OS, calibration, and whether values are specification, typical, or measured. | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range, sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and speed examples with conditions, including values that are specification, typical, nominal, or measured [45][49]. | Any comparison must preserve those conditions, because the passages distinguish guaranteed specifications from typical or measured data [1][45]. |
| Semiconductor-specific application evidence tying the VNA solution to the semiconductor use case, not just a generic product spec. | The AISeverEcosystem mapping lists R&S ZNA + ZNA67EXT and R&S FSWP for IC / silicon IP / process, but it explicitly does not say whether the measurement object is SerDes, jitter, phase noise, probe station, wafer, or package [82]. | The same mapping lists R&S ZNA67EXT for a test-interface company but does not specify probe card, socket, fixture, or frequency range [82]. |
| Direct comparison data between R&S and the competitor for the same Semiconductor application, DUT, and test setup. | The Samsung semiconductor-related case lists R&S FSWP50, SMW200A, SGS100A, competitor Keysight E5052B and VXG, and a 5G SoC including VCO, but the source provides no Keysight E5052B or VXG comparison data, so the competitor field is only sales-case context [40][42]. | The passages do not provide a direct VNA-vs-competitor comparison for Semiconductor with shared DUT, setup, metrics, or measured results [40][82]. |
| Complete test setup evidence: DUT, fixture/probe station, calibration method, frequency range, software version, and de-embedding method. | Semiconductor and high-speed interconnect cases show that win factors may involve total solution elements such as probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner rather than a single instrument specification [11]. | Several case summaries explicitly lack DUT details, frequency, fixture, calibration, topology, extender, probe, calibration, and de-embedding method [10][59]. |
| Comparable measurement conditions for numerical claims. | ZNB3000 measurement accuracy requires calibration and measurement frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be the same, with no interpolation [14]. | ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, and dynamic range can increase with 1 Hz measurement bandwidth, showing that conditions materially affect comparison claims [73]. |
| Evidence that market/customer claims are not being inferred from mapping or images. | AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping is only a sales/testing-solution lead and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [27]. | Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, market share, or R&S relationship claims [34]. |
### What cannot be claimed from the current passages
The current passages support that R&S ZNA and ZNB are VNA product lines with documented specifications, but they do not support a claim that they outperform Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor because the Keysight sources lack exact model, option, performance, and test-condition data [29][32][45][47].  
The current passages support that R&S ZNA/ZNA67EXT appears in semiconductor-adjacent IC and test-interface sales mappings, but they do not establish a verified Semiconductor test configuration or customer adoption because the mapping lacks measurement object, probe/fixture, and frequency-range details [27][82].  
The current passages support that a Samsung Foundry RF/Analog Enablement case names R&S instruments and Keysight competitors, but they do not provide comparison data, so it cannot be used as evidence that the R&S solution is better than the competitor solution [40][42].

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
